combo.description: Stack up your Q first, then E, Q Flash onto your enemy to engage. Follow that with an AA and your R. Then, batter your enemy down with AA, W, AA, Q and AA.
Use your E then Flash and then R your enemy through terrain! Follow that with a Q, AA, W, AA and Q again to finish if you're aiming for maximum burst!
Get your Q stacked up then Q Flash onto your enemy and AA them before using your R. then AA, W, AA and E Q to finish.
Stack up your Q then charge up your W to stun your enemy. Then AA, Q again, AA and then use your R. After that, finish the combo with another AA, Q and AA.
Stack up your Q, then E AA and Q to knock them back, then AA again before using your R! Then hit them with another AA, your W and another AA and Q again to finish.
Dash towards your enemy with your E and Q them. Then AA a few times before hitting your Q again! then AA, W, AA and Q again to finish.
Use your Q then auto attack until it's back off cooldown, then Q and AA again and finish off with your empowered Q and AA.
